DPP batteries mandatory (2027)
EAA legacy contracts (28 Jun 2027)

2 Dec 2027 — IF the Omnibus was
adopted before 2 Aug 2026 ⚠" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="134" width="200" x="1680" y="86" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="rowh" parent="1" style="text;html=1;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;fontSize=15;fontStyle=1;fontColor=#333333;" value="The 10 ideas, each under the clock that drives it" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="24" width="900" x="40" y="285" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="w02" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f8cecc;strokeColor=#b85450;fontSize=11;align=left;spacingLeft=8;verticalAlign=top;spacingTop=6;fontStyle=1" value="[W02] Accessibility remediation copilot
⭐ MOST URGENT + CHEAPEST

The only item here with LAWSUITS ALREADY FILED.
axe-core + Pa11y + Lighthouse → component attribution
→ drafted Angular patch → draft PR, never auto-merge.
⚠ automation catches ~1/3 of WCAG issues — say so." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="150" width="360" x="40" y="320" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="w01" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffe6cc;strokeColor=#d79b00;fontSize=11;align=left;spacingLeft=8;verticalAlign=top;spacingTop=6;fontStyle=1" value="[W01] EU AI Act compliance layer
⭐ THE DIFFERENTIATOR

Inventory · risk classification · provider-status guard
· FRIA · ONE INCIDENT, THREE CLOCKS (24h NIS2 /
72h GDPR / 15d AI Act).
Over half of organisations have no AI inventory." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="150" width="360" x="420" y="320" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="w07" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffe6cc;strokeColor=#d79b00;fontSize=11;align=left;spacingLeft=8;verticalAlign=top;spacingTop=6;fontStyle=1" value="[W07] Compliant workforce AI
⭐ NOBODY ELSE WILL DO THIS

V02 staff scheduling — "best pick" in the VTI set —
IS A HIGH-RISK AI SYSTEM IN THE EU (Annex III).
Still buildable: 7 obligations, 6 already built by I06.
The roster is decided by a SOLVER, not a model." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="150" width="360" x="800" y="320" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="w03" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#d5e8d4;strokeColor=#82b366;fontSize=11;align=left;spacingLeft=8;verticalAlign=top;spacingTop=6;fontStyle=1" value="[W03] Multi-protocol agentic merchant
⭐ supersedes set-1 idea 03

ACP = checkout · AP2 = payment CONSENT · UCP = merchant
AP2 donated to the FIDO Alliance 28 Apr 2026.
ChatGPT Instant Checkout shut down Mar 2026 —
the 4% fee is of UNCONFIRMED applicability." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="150" width="360" x="1180" y="320" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="w09" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#d5e8d4;strokeColor=#82b366;fontSize=11;align=left;spacingLeft=8;verticalAlign=top;spacingTop=6;fontStyle=1" value="[W09] Agent discovery optimisation
⭐ cheap, no owner anywhere

"optimise product data for AI agent discovery".
genAI traffic to US retail +4,700% YoY.
The failure is SILENT: an agent that cannot tell if a
shirt is cotton simply does not return it." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="150" width="340" x="1560" y="320" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="w06" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#d5e8d4;strokeColor=#82b366;fontSize=11;align=left;spacingLeft=8;verticalAlign=top;spacingTop=6;fontStyle=1" value="[W06] Fixed-camera shelf intelligence
⭐ better than a robot, in the West

Bossa Nova: 500+ Walmart stores, CANCELLED Nov 2020,
vendor laid off 50%. All three reasons non-technical:
labour re-deployment flipped the ROI · CUSTOMER
DISCOMFORT with six-foot machines · simpler methods won.
"Fixed cameras imperil the value of robotic scanning."" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="160" width="360" x="40" y="490" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="w05" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#d5e8d4;strokeColor=#82b366;fontSize=11;align=left;spacingLeft=8;verticalAlign=top;spacingTop=6;" value="[W05] Warehouse fleet orchestration

Back-of-house automates before front-of-house —
the 2026 capital flows confirm it.
Amazon ≥€10B in EUROPE · Symbotic↔Walmart fused
· 85,000+ units deployed. Amazon's stack is CLOSED;
what you can buy is Locus / Geek+ / AutoStore.
R02's layer, DC scope, carrier cut-off as the clock." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="160" width="360" x="420" y="490" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="w04" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#fff2cc;strokeColor=#d6b656;fontSize=11;align=left;spacingLeft=8;verticalAlign=top;spacingTop=6;" value="[W04] Digital Product Passport readiness

ESPR in force; delegated acts 2026–2030;
batteries mandatory 2027; textiles/electronics priority.
NOT an AI project — a product-data project with a
legal deadline. AI does exactly two jobs:
supplier-document extraction, and gap detection.
Double duty: DPP + CSRD + W10 + W09 from one build." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="160" width="360" x="800" y="490" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="w10" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#fff2cc;strokeColor=#d6b656;fontSize=11;align=left;spacingLeft=8;verticalAlign=top;spacingTop=6;" value="[W10] Circularity: returns → resale → reporting

I04 stops returns; W10 recovers value from the rest.
The leak is the INSPECTION DECISION — made in
seconds without knowing resale value or stock position.
Counter-metric that keeps it honest:
restock-to-second-return rate.
CSRD export from the same records." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="160" width="360" x="1180" y="490" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="w08" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f5f5f5;strokeColor=#999999;fontSize=11;align=left;spacingLeft=8;verticalAlign=top;spacingTop=6;" value="[W08] Sidewalk / road robots
+ micro-fulfilment

⚠ Western robot-vendor SCALE NOT VERIFIED
in this research round — stated openly.
What survives: the ORIGIN decision, which
micro-fulfilment makes a real choice.
Regulation is city-level → route availability as DATA." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="160" width="340" x="1560" y="490" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="diff" parent="1" style="swimlane;startSize=34;html=1;whiteSpace=wrap;fillColor=#f9f9f9;strokeColor=#999999;fontStyle=1;fontSize=13;" value="Four ways the West differs from China — and each one changes a design" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="240" width="1160" x="40" y="680" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="d1" parent="diff" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#dae8fc;strokeColor=#6c8ebf;fontSize=11;align=left;spacingLeft=8;verticalAlign=top;spacingTop=6;" value="BINDING CONSTRAINT
China: data residency (PIPL) → domestic inference
West: regulation of the AI SYSTEM → documented
 oversight, ≥6-month logs, FRIA" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="88" width="550" x="20" y="44" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="d2" parent="diff" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#dae8fc;strokeColor=#6c8ebf;fontSize=11;align=left;spacingLeft=8;verticalAlign=top;spacingTop=6;" value="LABOUR
China: 4.5M worker shortfall → robots substitute
West: high cost, BUT Bossa Nova shows ROI flips
 when labour is re-deployed. Back-of-house first." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="88" width="550" x="590" y="44" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="d3" parent="diff" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#dae8fc;strokeColor=#6c8ebf;fontSize=11;align=left;spacingLeft=8;verticalAlign=top;spacingTop=6;" value="COMMERCE CHANNEL
China: livestream ¥7.2T · 私域 · 社区团购
West: agentic commerce — 75% of NRF retailers
 building it, ~1% of shoppers using it" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="88" width="550" x="20" y="140" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="d4" parent="diff" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#dae8fc;strokeColor=#6c8ebf;fontSize=11;align=left;spacingLeft=8;verticalAlign=top;spacingTop=6;" value="STORE ROBOTICS
China: scaling — Pudu and Keenon #1 and #1 globally
West: customer-facing store robotics are FRAGILE.
 Fixed cameras often win. → W06" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="88" width="550" x="590" y="140" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="reuse" parent="1" style="swimlane;startSize=34;html=1;whiteSpace=wrap;fillColor=#f3faf1;strokeColor=#82b366;fontStyle=1;fontSize=13;fontColor=#3d7a2a;" value="What we already built that satisfies this" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="240" width="660" x="1240" y="680" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="r1" parent="reuse" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#d5e8d4;strokeColor=#82b366;fontSize=11;align=left;spacingLeft=10;verticalAlign=top;spacingTop=8;fontFamily=Courier New;" value="EU AI Act Article 26 obligation → what we already run
──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
automatic event logging, ≥6 months → ai_decision (I06) + OTel
operational human-oversight controls → I06 human_action + OPA gate (N-12)
technical documentation → model &amp; data register + MLflow
discriminatory-impact monitoring → Evidently slice metrics
content marking (2 Dec 2026) → the SAME mechanism as 标识办法
incident 24h / 72h / 15d → NEW — one record, three routes (W01)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="140" width="620" x="20" y="44" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="r2" parent="reuse" style="text;html=1;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;fontSize=12;fontStyle=1;fontColor=#3d7a2a;" value="Six of the eight Western compliance items are already built by I06 and I05." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="24" width="620" x="20" y="192" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="rec" parent="1" style="rounded=0;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f3faf1;strokeColor=#82b366;fontSize=12;align=left;spacingLeft=12;verticalAlign=middle;fontStyle=1" value="Recommended: W02 → W01 → W09, with W07 as the compliance showpiece. Add W06 if a store demo is wanted — explaining WHY WE DID NOT USE A ROBOT is a stronger segment than a robot driving down an aisle.
Check first, it is a yes/no lookup that moves a deadline by 16 months: was the AI Act Digital Omnibus formally adopted before 2 August 2026?" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="90" width="1860" x="40" y="950" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="lic" parent="1" style="rounded=0;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#fffdf5;strokeColor=#d6b656;fontSize=11;align=left;spacingLeft=12;verticalAlign=middle;" value="Western licence pattern — different trap from China. Not non-commercial weights, but INFRASTRUCTURE PROJECTS RELICENSING AFTER YOU DEPEND ON THEM: Terraform (BSL 2023 → OpenTofu) · Redis (RSAL/SSPL 2024 → AGPL 2025 → Valkey) ·
Elasticsearch (SSPL 2021 → AGPL 2024 → OpenSearch) · MongoDB (SSPL) · Grafana (AGPL). We already run Redis, Elasticsearch and Grafana. Conditional model licences: Llama (MAU threshold) · Gemma (not OSI) · Mistral (mixed per model).
Design rule: prefer Apache-2.0 / MIT / BSD under a FOUNDATION (CNCF, LF AI &amp; Data, Apache) over single-vendor open core — which is why OPA, OpenTelemetry, Milvus, Open-RMF and OpenTofu recur across all six folders." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="110" width="1860" x="40" y="1060" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="foot" parent="1" style="text;html=1;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;fontSize=11;fontColor=#666666;" value="Every claim is sourced in 00-west-regulation.md and 00-west-market-research.md. The Bossa Nova reporting is contemporaneous 2020 news and is the most solid evidence in this folder; agentic-commerce and robotics market figures include vendor and consultancy material." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="20" width="1860" x="40" y="1190" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e1" edge="1" parent="1" source="t3" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=1;orthogonalLoop=1;jettySize=auto;html=1;strokeColor=#b85450;strokeWidth=2;dashed=1;exitX=0.5;exitY=1;exitDx=0;exitDy=0;entryX=0.5;entryY=0;entryDx=0;entryDy=0;" target="w02" value=""> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e2" edge="1" parent="1" source="t5" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=1;orthogonalLoop=1;jettySize=auto;html=1;strokeColor=#d79b00;strokeWidth=2;dashed=1;exitX=0.5;exitY=1;exitDx=0;exitDy=0;entryX=0.5;entryY=0;entryDx=0;entryDy=0;" target="w03" value=""> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e3" edge="1" parent="1" source="t7" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=1;orthogonalLoop=1;jettySize=auto;html=1;strokeColor=#d6b656;strokeWidth=2;dashed=1;exitX=0.5;exitY=1;exitDx=0;exitDy=0;entryX=0.9;entryY=0;entryDx=0;entryDy=0;" target="w09" value=""> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </root> </mxGraphModel> </diagram> </mxfile>

div.div:
[W02] Accessibility remediation copilot
⭐ MOST URGENT + CHEAPEST
The only item here with LAWSUITS ALREADY FILED.
axe-core + Pa11y + Lighthouse → component attribution
→ drafted Angular patch → draft PR, never auto-merge.
⚠ automation catches ~1/3 of WCAG issues — say so.

[W01] EU AI Act compliance layer
⭐ THE DIFFERENTIATOR
Inventory · risk classification · provider-status guard
· FRIA · ONE INCIDENT, THREE CLOCKS (24h NIS2 /
72h GDPR / 15d AI Act).
Over half of organisations have no AI inventory.

[W07] Compliant workforce AI
⭐ NOBODY ELSE WILL DO THIS
V02 staff scheduling — "best pick" in the VTI set —
IS A HIGH-RISK AI SYSTEM IN THE EU (Annex III).
Still buildable: 7 obligations, 6 already built by I06.
The roster is decided by a SOLVER, not a model.

⭐ supersedes set-1 idea 03
ACP = checkout · AP2 = payment CONSENT · UCP = merchant
AP2 donated to the FIDO Alliance 28 Apr 2026.
ChatGPT Instant Checkout shut down Mar 2026 —
the 4% fee is of UNCONFIRMED applicability.

div.div:
[W09] Agent discovery optimisation
⭐ cheap, no owner anywhere
"optimise product data for AI agent discovery".
genAI traffic to US retail +4,700% YoY.
The failure is SILENT: an agent that cannot tell if a
shirt is cotton simply does not return it.

div.div:
[W06] Fixed-camera shelf intelligence
⭐ better than a robot, in the West
Bossa Nova: 500+ Walmart stores, CANCELLED Nov 2020,
vendor laid off 50%. All three reasons non-technical:
labour re-deployment flipped the ROI · CUSTOMER
DISCOMFORT with six-foot machines · simpler methods won.
"Fixed cameras imperil the value of robotic scanning."

div.div:
[W05] Warehouse fleet orchestration
Back-of-house automates before front-of-house —
the 2026 capital flows confirm it.
Amazon ≥€10B in EUROPE · Symbotic↔Walmart fused
· 85,000+ units deployed. Amazon's stack is CLOSED;
what you can buy is Locus / Geek+ / AutoStore.
R02's layer, DC scope, carrier cut-off as the clock.

div.div:
[W04] Digital Product Passport readiness
ESPR in force; delegated acts 2026–2030;
batteries mandatory 2027; textiles/electronics priority.
NOT an AI project — a product-data project with a
legal deadline. AI does exactly two jobs:
supplier-document extraction, and gap detection.
Double duty: DPP + CSRD + W10 + W09 from one build.

div.div:
[W10] Circularity: returns → resale → reporting
I04 stops returns; W10 recovers value from the rest.
The leak is the INSPECTION DECISION — made in
seconds without knowing resale value or stock position.
Counter-metric that keeps it honest:
restock-to-second-return rate.
CSRD export from the same records.

Regulation is city-level → route availability as DATA.

LABOUR
China: 4.5M worker shortfall → robots substitute
West: high cost, BUT Bossa Nova shows ROI flips
when labour is re-deployed. Back-of-house first.

China: livestream ¥7.2T · 私域 · 社区团购

building it, ~1% of shoppers using it

automatic event logging, ≥6 months → ai_decision (I06) + OTel

div.div:
Recommended: W02 → W01 → W09, with W07 as the compliance showpiece. Add W06 if a store demo is wanted — explaining WHY WE DID NOT USE A ROBOT is a stronger segment than a robot driving down an aisle.
Check first, it is a yes/no lookup that moves a deadline by 16 months: was the AI Act Digital Omnibus formally adopted before 2 August 2026?

div.div:
Western licence pattern — different trap from China. Not non-commercial weights, but INFRASTRUCTURE PROJECTS RELICENSING AFTER YOU DEPEND ON THEM: Terraform (BSL 2023 → OpenTofu) · Redis (RSAL/SSPL 2024 → AGPL 2025 → Valkey) ·
Elasticsearch (SSPL 2021 → AGPL 2024 → OpenSearch) · MongoDB (SSPL) · Grafana (AGPL). We already run Redis, Elasticsearch and Grafana. Conditional model licences: Llama (MAU threshold) · Gemma (not OSI) · Mistral (mixed per model).
Design rule: prefer Apache-2.0 / MIT / BSD under a FOUNDATION (CNCF, LF AI & Data, Apache) over single-vendor open core — which is why OPA, OpenTelemetry, Milvus, Open-RMF and OpenTofu recur across all six folders.
